title: Customer Relations Note on the Goodwill Credit for a Slow Design
content:
# Customer Relations Note on the Goodwill Credit for a Slow Design

Where a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is closed at the customer's request, the goodwill credit given for a design that took too long turns on the days between the commission being opened at the consultation and the design being approved, and on whether any stage of production stands recorded on the commission.

## The credits

1. Where more than the studio's long design delay days, which are 70 calendar days, passed between the commission being opened at the consultation and the design being approved, and no stage of production stands recorded on the commission, the studio's major goodwill credit of 4 per cent of the remainder is given.
2. Where more than the studio's design delay days, which are 35 calendar days, but not more than its long design delay days passed between those two dates, and no stage of production stands recorded, the studio's minor goodwill credit of 2 per cent of the remainder is given.
3. Otherwise no goodwill credit is given for a design that took too long.

The date the commission was opened at the consultation and the date the customer approved the design both stand on the commission record. A stage of production stands recorded where at least one production stage entry has been booked to the commission; where one has, no goodwill credit is given however long the design took.

## Day counts (hypothetical)

On a remainder of USD 10000.00, with no stage of production recorded:

| Days between the consultation and the design being approved | Credit |
|---|---|
| 35 | No goodwill credit is given for a design that took too long |
| 36 | 2 per cent, that is USD 200.00 |
| 70 | 2 per cent, that is USD 200.00 |
| 71 | 4 per cent, that is USD 400.00 |
